title: What I Talk About When I Talk About Running
author: Haruki Murakami
summary: Haruki Murakami reflects on running and writing, recounting how he started jogging, trained for marathons and a triathlon, and what the habit gives his work.
readIf: you like quiet, reflective memoir about discipline, running or writing.
skipIf: you want a training plan or lots of Murakami's fiction themes.
